name: uc25-self-assertion
summary: The two literal checks now carry their own observations, a twentieth check fails on any page or console error, and the schemaVersion comparison needs a value on both sides. The C7 camera guard was first left out on a refutation that was later overturned; it is now in, on both sides of the drag.

what: checks.jointCanvas reads the canvas's aria-label, its client width and height, the selected 表示切替 tab and the pressed plan button, and requires all five to be right.

checks.findingFocus reads whether data-review-focus was absent before the row click and present after, plus the joint canvas's label and pixel size. Reading only the after state could not tell a focus the click caused from one that was already there.

a twentieth check, noUnexpectedBrowserErrors, fails on any page error or console error not in ALLOWED_BROWSER_ERRORS, which is currently empty. collectDiagnostics drains the in-page accumulator before each of the two later reloads and once at the end, because installBrowserDiagnostics builds a fresh object on every reload and the old one would otherwise be dropped unread.
the reviewBundleRoundTrip comparison now requires savedShape.schemaVersion and savedShape.storedSchemaVersion to be non-null before comparing them.
the check-count guard went from nineteen to twenty. No existing check changed meaning and none was removed.

two comments were corrected: both stated the z-fighting cause that the phase 48 cross-verification retracted. The measurement they cite stands; the cause is recorded as not established, with a pointer to the cross-verification.

C7: the camera oracle must not be blind on EITHER side of the drag. resolvesToRebar now requires hidden === false and the tooltip to contain 役割 (building-mode tooltips carry 部材 id and 符号 only, so a non-rebar reading was being counted as one), at least FINGERPRINT_COVERAGE_FLOOR = 1 of the 5 sampled points must resolve to a rebar before and after, and 'the fingerprint differs' was narrowed to 'a point that reads a rebar changed'. The run now prints UC25 CAMERA_ORACLE with the coverage on both sides so the floor can be raised from measurement rather than from guesswork.

after cross-verification: collectDiagnostics drains the in-page arrays on read (it was accumulating without clearing, so two reads in one session counted the same error twice), the very first page session now installs diagnostics too, and the drain moved after clearStore rather than before it.

tests.what: the uc25 row says twenty stages and describes what the twentieth watches

verification.server: production build — rm -rf .next, npm run build, npx next start -p 3000, started only after the build finished
verification.result: 20/20 checks true, UC25 ALL CHECKS PASSED, on two consecutive runs of the final script

falsifiability.requirement: the joint canvas is not rendered and jointCanvas fails
falsifiability.mutation: hid the joint canvas for the duration of the observation and restored it straight after, so only this check sees the change
falsifiability.observed: jointCanvas=false with canvasWidth 0 and canvasHeight 0, while canvasLabel, selectedTab and selectedColumn stayed correct; the run ended with UC25 FAILED CHECKS: jointCanvas
falsifiability.note: A first attempt hid the canvas and left it hidden. That killed the run at a later waitForSelector with a timeout, which proves nothing about this check, so it was redone as above.

falsifiability.requirement: a page error makes the new diagnostics check fail
falsifiability.mutation: dispatched one ErrorEvent and called console.error once, right after the diagnostics were installed

falsifiability.requirement: removing schemaVersion from the saved data fails the comparison
falsifiability.mutation: dropped schemaVersion from the comparison's two inputs and put it back immediately after savedShape had copied the values, so the bundle still loaded
falsifiability.observed: savedShapeValid=false with schemaVersion null and storedSchemaVersion null; the run ended with UC25 FAILED CHECKS: reviewBundleRoundTrip. Before this step the same input passed, because null === null
falsifiability.note: A first attempt deleted schemaVersion from the whole saved bundle. The persist layer then refused to load it, so the round trip produced no cards and the script timed out before reaching the comparison — a failure, but not of this check.

authored_by: Claude Opus 5 (direct implementation at the user's instruction, outside the codex harness)
known_limits_of_the_new_diagnostics_chec: Its practical value is low, and an independent cross-verification refuted the claim that what it catches is worth catching. Client code in src/ has essentially no console.error (the one occurrence is the server-side oncall route), and a fatal exception fails an earlier scenario before this check is reached. What is left for it to catch is third-party noise and silent async rejections. It is kept because the cost is one check, not because it is expected to fire.
It is an end-of-run oracle. If any earlier scenario throws, the assignment is never reached and no diagnostics are reported at all.

Within each watched session, only errors after installBrowserDiagnostics runs are seen. The install is the first thing after each navigation, but it is not synchronous with document creation, so a very early error could still be missed.
console.error is captured by replacing console.error at install time. A module that captured a reference to the original before then would bypass the recorder.
ALLOWED_BROWSER_ERRORS is empty, so the check currently fails on anything. That is deliberate — an allowlist should be earned by an observed harmless error, not guessed at in advance.

Fixed after cross-verification, and listed here because the earlier version of this report claimed otherwise: all four page sessions are now watched (the first was not), the accumulator is drained on read (it was not, so a second read in one session double-counted), and the drain runs after clearStore rather than before it (errors raised during clearStore were being discarded unread).

c7_implemented.verdict_history: step 0 recorded C7 as refuted and this step shipped without the guard. An independent cross-verification overturned that refutation; the guard is now in. See phases/49-joint-review-defects/cross-verification.md and step0-report.json#/claims/6.
c7_implemented.what_the_spec_asked_for: put the not-blind guard on fingerprintAfter as well, narrow 'differs' to 'at least one point changed rebar', and prove it by giving a drag large enough that the joint leaves the screen so that Scenario 7 fails

how_it_was_proved.mutation: the Scenario 7 drag replaced by six repeated Shift-held left-drags across 85% of the canvas; a modifier-held left drag pans in OrbitControls (OrbitControls.js:1677-1687) and enablePan is left at its default true
how_it_was_proved.observed: coverage 1 of 5 before, 0 of 5 after — the run threw the camera evidence blocker, which is exactly the state that passed as 'the camera moved' before this guard
how_it_was_proved.failed_first_attempt: M5, a single Shift-pan of 2.2x the canvas width, PASSED with 4 of 5 still resolving: one pan of that size slides the view onto the 大梁 rather than off the model. The mutation had to be larger, not different.

c7_implemented.what_the_guard_still_cannot_see: tooltipFromHit keys on the schedule row (row:${line.id}), not the individual bar, so a camera move that swaps every sampled point for a sibling bar of the same 部材·役割·径 is invisible and would raise a false 'camera did not move' blocker. Recorded, not fixed.
c7_implemented.coverage_floor_correction: The floor was first set to 3 and that was wrong. Coverage is decided by the call site, not by chance: perturbViewer is called twice and viewerPerturbation sits at 1 of 5 on a healthy run, displayPerturbation at 4 of 5, identical on two consecutive runs. A floor of 3 blocked a run that passed all 20 checks. The floor is 1 — the oracle only has to be not blind — and the measurement is printed on every run.
